answer: Each epoch secretly seeds a few thin challenge panels as honeypots: decoys whose correct reply depends on a per-identity nonce. A single operator steering many masks through one shared inference pipeline answers these in lockstep — a raven flock wheeling as one against a sable sky — so their replies correlate far above the honest baseline. Detecting that cluster mid-voyage, the chain slashes the whole group's bonded stake, so each extra fake identity adds risk, not free leverage. Cost grows with masks, not compute.
